description: Look back at what agents ran into here and get numbered proposals, each with its evidence: API names agents keep guessing (a project hint that the session start and three_api show), messages nothing explained (a draft lesson to finish with three_lesson_add), local lessons that misled or say the same thing (retire, merge), review rules that are often false alarms here, and tools whose writes keep being undone. No model, no network; only counters on this machine. Show the list to the user and pass `apply` with the numbers they approve: hints go through the journal (three_undo), lesson removals change the local lessons file.

all.description: also show proposals applied or set aside before

apply.description: proposal numbers of the last list, or their keys, to apply

detail.description: brief (capped, short) or full (everything); default brief

path.description: Project folder, or a file or folder in it (relative to the server's folder; default: the project).

name: three_dream
title: Learn from past sessions on this machine
